text:
Sam: Quick sync — Aurora Bank POC onboarding. They want two core flows: 1) conversational deposit routing (intent classification + slot fill) and 2) KYC doc extraction (PDF scans). Timeline they suggested ~6 weeks. Can we align success criteria and owners?
Maria: Thanks Sam. Can you paste the customer acceptance asks? Also please confirm whether they'll share sample data (redacted).
Sam: They agreed to share a redacted sample set this week. High-level acceptance asks from Aurora: intent accuracy on routing >= 92%, entity extraction F1 >= 88%, 95th pct latency < 250ms for chat path, and runbook for redaction + audit logs.
Omar: I'll own the eval harness + prompts. Plan: generate 500 prompt variations for routing, 300 doc extraction samples, run automatic metrics + manual spot checks.
Leah: Heads up — Aurora requires SSO + KMS + private subnet for test data. That likely means Private deployment (VPC). That's a blocker for hosted trial unless we get exception.
Raj: Pricing note: Private deployment has an onboarding/platform fee + infra. Ballpark for a 6-week pilot (private) = platform fee $12k + reserved capacity estimate $7k/mo. If they go hosted, can do a lower entry price but no VPC.
sec-bot: Automated: Security questionnaire stub: https://redwood.example.com/sec-q/questionnaire-aurora (owner: @Leah). KMS integrations: AWS KMS, GCP KMS supported.
Sam: Proposed minimal endpoint list for POC (for devs):
```
POST /v1/chat -> conversational routing (returns intent, confidence, reply)
POST /v1/parse-docs -> document extraction (returns entities + page refs)
POST /v1/embed -> for semantic search of policies
```
Maria: Acceptance test ideas:
- Routing: sample set of 500 queries, target >=92% intent match vs gold labels.
- Doc extraction: 300 scanned docs, entity F1 >= 88% and named entities present.
- Stability: 99% uptime during test window; no >5s tail latency spikes.
Omar: For prompts/evals I'll seed with current bank transcripts + synthetic variations. Suggest nightly eval runs and a leaderboard + regression alert. I'll add demo notebook.
Leah: Security blocker details: data residency needed in eu-west-1 for Aurora. We must confirm Private deployment location and KMS key ownership. Also need to answer questionnaire Q12 (data retention) and Q18 (redaction process). I can take Q12/Q18.
Raj: Commercial ask: if they commit to a 6-month pilot with reserved capacity we can discount platform fee by 25%. Need to flag procurement timeline.
Sam: Operational blockers: Aurora wants token-level cost estimate for typical session (avg 120 tokens request, 220 tokens response) — @Raj can you produce a cost estimate for hosted vs private?
Raj: Will do. Quick back-of-envelope: hosted ~ $1.8 per 1k tokens with our standard small model, private depends on infra but estimate $1.1–$1.5 per 1k tokens once amortized. I'll send a short spreadsheet.
Maria: UX/Integration ask: Customer wants an endpoint that returns structured routing decisions (intent + next-action). We'll prototype the response schema like: `{intent: "deposit", confidence: 0.96, next_action: "ask-amount"}`.
Omar: I'll include that in the eval harness and add a prompt template set for follow-ups. Sample prompt snippet: 
```
System: You are a bank routing assistant.
User: I want to deposit a check.
Expected: intent:deposit, slots:{amount, account_type}
```
Sam: Can we commit owners: Omar = evals & demo, Leah = security questionnaire & onboarding, Raj = pricing & cost estimate, Maria = acceptance tests & runbook, Sam = customer PM + kickoff scheduling.
Leah: Confirmed. I'll start questionnaire and ask Aurora for examples of PII to redact and the certs they require.
Omar: I'll push the eval harness by Thursday and share the leaderboard.
Raj: I'll send pricing sheet and proposal draft by EOD tomorrow.
Maria: I'll draft acceptance test checklist and a short integration README for Aurora engineers.
Sam: Great — scheduling a 30m scoping call with Aurora for tomorrow 10:30 PDT. I'll post invite. Anything else? :eyes:
Maria: Add a short item to check SSL/TLS termination and client certs for private endpoint.
Leah: Also request a point-of-contact for legal + compliance on their side.
Sam: Noted. Thanks team — will follow up after the call with an updated milestone plan (week-by-week). :thumbsup:
